summary: Native SwiftUI root surfaces and iOS 26 shared chrome primitives are source-present, but frontend proof is Red: zero proven mature surfaces in the current control-plane dashboard, receipt coverage missing across the mature universe, no current screenshot/manual visual proof packet, and accessibility/runtime/release proof remain unproven.

environment_limitations: No full build or simulator screenshot capture was run for this audit.

surface_matrix.surface_name: Today Root / Reality Meridian + Start Here

ios_api.availability_guarding_evidence: No direct iOS 26 symbol in Today root files; shared chrome uses guarded glass helper.
candidate_ios26_api_opportunities: Only consider iOS 26 glass/surface APIs if they improve Start Here native material fidelity or reduce brittle custom chrome.
ios_api.risk_if_adopted: Could add visual churn before Start Here proof is established.
ios_api.risk_if_not_adopted: Low; shared shell already carries iOS 26 native chrome.
ios_api.recommended_action: Do not add direct iOS 26 APIs until Today visual/runtime proof identifies a concrete need.

findings.title: Task copy appears in user-facing Goals flow
findings.evidence: Copy says the item is still a standalone Task.
findings.why_it_matters: Canonical action-item language is Step unless normal English is clearly non-object usage.

findings.title: Accessibility conformance remains unproven
findings.evidence: Release truth forbids fully accessible, VoiceOver verified, Dynamic Type verified, and Reduce Motion verified claims without current proof.
findings.why_it_matters: Premium native frontend cannot be complete without accessibility proof.
findings.ios_api_relevance: Liquid Glass fallback proof must include accessibility settings.
